test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not correct when fitting internal combustion (IC) engine rings?

options.text: The most important precaution is to carefully check the end gap of each ring to ensure proper ring gap and alignment.
The use of special tools is essential to install the rings without twisting or damaging them.
This is very important for maintaining proper combustion pressure and preventing oil consumption problems.
The piston head sealing surface needs to be thoroughly cleaned.

solution:
The correct answer is __The piston head sealing surface needs to be thoroughly cleaned**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• End gap__ of each piston ring should be carefully checked to ensure proper alignment and performance.
 
• Special tools are essential to install rings without causing damage or twisting them.
 
• Proper installation of rings is crucial for maintaining combustion pressure and preventing excessive oil consumption.
 
• Cleaning the piston head sealing surface is not a mandatory requirement when fitting IC engine rings, as it does not directly affect the installation of the rings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Piston Ring Functions:**

 
 
• Piston rings are responsible for sealing the combustion chamber to prevent gas leakage.
 
• They help in dissipating heat from the piston to the cylinder walls.
 
• They also control oil consumption by scraping excess oil from the cylinder walls.
 
 
 
• **Precautions While Installing Rings:**
 
 
• Ensure correct ring orientation as per manufacturer specifications.
 
• Use ring compressors to safely insert the piston with rings into the cylinder.
 
• Do not over-stretch or force the rings during installation.
